name: GC Minimal Zine Poster
tagline: A Codex skill for generating minimal zine-style editorial poster pages
description: GC Minimal Zine Poster is a Codex skill that generates minimal zine-style editorial poster pages. It encodes a tight, constrained visual language — stark typography, generous whitespace, and a zine's hand-made editorial feel — so an agent can produce consistently designed posters on demand. As a skill it slots into the growing workflow of having coding agents generate finished design artifacts rather than just code. With 5.3k stars it has become a popular reference for design-oriented agent skills.
highlights: Codex skill that produces minimal zine-style editorial poster pages
Encodes a constrained visual language: stark typography and hand-made editorial feel
Lets a coding agent generate finished design artifacts, not just code
5.3k stars as a popular design-oriented agent skill
curatorNote: A great example of turning a strong visual taste into a repeatable agent skill. The constrained zine aesthetic means outputs stay on-brand instead of drifting into generic AI-art territory.
